# testdata/catalogs/e2e

A two-entry catalog (`jq`, `gh`) for the end-to-end tests in [cmd/facman](../../../cmd/facman/): `--catalog <dir>` replacing the embedded catalog, profile union (`e2e` + `tools`), conflicting pins (`e2e` + `other` exit 3), and the crash-recovery test. Test data only; never shipped. Back to [testdata/catalogs](../README.md).
